articles.title: Web3 gaming network Sandbox stops Base and BNB chain bridging after exploit
articles.snippet: The Sandbox disabled bridging on affected networks to isolate tokens and warned users not to trade SAND on Base and BNB, citing an impact of under 0.01% of supply.

articles.title: Kalshi off-limits in multiple states as prediction markets, CFTC team up for battle
articles.snippet: Washington state is cut off for Kalshi customers while the company combats the development in court and its federal regulator keeps pursuing new rules.

articles.title: How a Treasury buyback tweak helped bitcoin surge 25% to nearly $80,000 in days
articles.snippet: Treasury buybacks are not QE, analysts said, but the move helped pull long-term yields off 19-year highs and triggered a record short squeeze in a market already leaning too bearish.

articles.title: Nomura-backed Laser Digital wins Japan's first crypto approval in four years
articles.snippet: Laser Digital Japan will offer liquidity to domestic crypto providers, with institutional trading services planned to follow as the appetite for crypto in Japan grows.

articles.title: Fed study finds crypto investors driven by beliefs, easily swayed by returns
articles.snippet: A Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland study finds crypto investors hold sharply different views on returns and risk, while information about Bitcoin’s past gains can increase both desired allocations and actual crypto purchases.
